title: feat(ui): browse the holder library in the tool library window
body:
U6 of the tool library redesign (#3663). The tool library window gets a Holders page: the built-in holders by spindle taper and a read-only holder view. This PR also closes the five gaps between U1 to U5 and the mock-up of #3663 (the scope comments on #3897).

Stacked on #3935 (U5). The commits of this PR only: https://github.com/qsmits/Camcraft/compare/b82b017bb...issue/3897-tool-holders-list

Update: #3931 and #3935 merged into `main` (#3935 at its head `b82b017bb`, the base of this branch). The PR diff against `main` now shows the U6 commits only. The gate below merged origin/main `b13ebd440`, before those merges. GitHub reports the PR as mergeable with the current `main` (`02d05bc1c`).

## Two commits, two subjects
The UI refit rule asks for one page or component in each PR. The user decided to fold the mock-up gaps into U6, because each PR is costly on this project. So the PR keeps the rule by commit:
1. `dd129ab43` `feat(ui): close the tool library window's gaps to the mock-up`: the five layout items, their tests and the updated `layout_window_tool_*` tests. It does not build alone, by a split error (see the gate).
2. `3c622f8e5` `feat(ui): browse the holder library in the tool library window`: the Holders page, the used-by query in app, their tests and `layout_window_holders`.

The two belong together because they change the same window: the page switch heads the window, and the wider window and the two-column editor are the frame that the Holders page and the holder view use.

## What changed
Mock-up gaps (commit 1), all display only, no command:
1. **Editor layout.** The tabs and their rows stand on the left, the preview on the right (mock-up picture 2). U3 put the preview above the tabs.
2. **Preview toggles.** "Dimensions" and "Holder" check boxes beside the 3D / Side toggle (view state in `EditorFace`, both on). Holder off: the 3D view shows the model without the holder (`ToolModel::bare`, built with the model), and the side view shows no holder bands and no holder dimension. Dimensions off: the side view draws no dimension line. The flutes toggle comes with #3908.
3. **List rows.** Each Document row starts with a small drawing of the tool (`tool_library_dialog/thumbs.rs`: cached by the tool name and keyed on the tool value; a still frame only moves the kept shapes). A new "Gauge length" column shows the holder's gauge length plus the stick-out for a tool in a library holder. A tool with a drawn body, a mesh body or the stand-in cylinder shows "-", because its gauge line is not stated.
4. **Categories.** U2 did not add them. A column on the left of the list (`categories.rs`) groups the tools by kind under Milling, Hole making, Turning and Other, each category with its count (mock-up picture 1). A category with no tool in the shown source is not listed. A pick filters the rows, as the Tool type choice does (which stays).
5. **Window width.** The window opens `WIDE_W` wide (rail 170 + rows 780 + preview 320 + margins = 1330 px), so the Recipes table and the preview show side by side without a horizontal scroll bar. The window stands left of the Properties pane. On a narrower screen it takes the room left of Properties (it then covers the browser), and the Recipes table scrolls across as before. The minimum width is the same width.

Review fix (commit 3, `29af2e3e1`, the review of `3c622f8e5`):
- On a narrow window the rail folds from 170 px to 120 px (`rail_w`). The preview keeps 250 px while the rows keep 280 px (`columns`).
- The side view's dimension room gives way before the drawing (`side_view::margins`). With Dimensions off, the room is a thin 8 px border. With Dimensions on, the room shrinks in proportion, so the drawing keeps 96 px (`MIN_DRAW`). The painter clips a dimension value at the edge of the area.
- On a 960 px screen the drawing now paints. Before the fix, the side view took its early return and drew nothing.

Holders page (commit 2):
- A "Cutting tools | Holders" switch heads the window. The mock-up says "Tools". "Tools" is already the ribbon cell that opens the window (two buttons of one name break each test and MCP flow that clicks it), and "Tool list" is a browser row. See the decision file.
- `tool_library_dialog/holders.rs`: `holder_library::library()` grouped by taper, the mounted machine's taper (`tooling.spindle_mount`) first and marked "(machine)". Columns: Name, Taper, Clamp, Clamps Ø, Gauge length, Largest Ø, Used by. A taper column on the left ("All holders" and each taper with its count), a name filter, and a note on the mounted machine's taper.
- `tool_library_dialog/holder_view.rs`: the read-only holder view (mock-up picture 5). Machine side (spindle taper, marked when it is the machine's), tool side (clamp and clamping range), shape (gauge length, largest diameter, nose diameter), "Used by N tools" with each tool's stick-out and gauge length (a click opens the tool in the editor), and the outline to scale with its dimension lines and a Dimensions toggle. The outline's shapes and labels are cached on the holder, the rect, the unit and the toggle.
- The view says: "Built-in holders are read-only. User holders and holder edits come with the user library (#3645)." "New holder", Import, Export, edit boxes, Duplicate and Apply on a holder are U7 (#3898).
- App: `tool_body::holder_users(world)` and `tool_body::tools_using_holder(world, entry)`, keyed on `HolderRef::entry` (case and spacing ignored, as `holder_library::find`). A read of the world, so it is in app.
- Decision: `docs/decisions/3897-tool-holders-list.md`.

Commands: none. Browsing, the toggles and the picks are view state. No MCP tool is owed: `get_job` already shows each tool's `holder.library`.

## Readings
Seeded document, the end mill `EM-0600-4FL` put in `BT40 ER32` with the defaults: the list shows "1 tool" on the BT40 ER32 row, and the holder view lists the tool with its stick-out and gauge length. The built-in library groups as BT30, BT40, CAT40, TTS and straight shank. On a 1920 x 1080 screen the window is 1330 px wide; the Recipes table's `fz` column stands left of the preview.

## Pinning tests
New (ui lib, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/`):
- `tool_library_holders_ui::a_holder_lists_the_tools_that_use_it`: the count in the list, the holder view, the tool link opens the editor, no command.
- `tool_library_holders_ui::the_machine_taper_comes_first_and_a_taper_filters_the_list`
- `tool_library_holders_ui::a_still_frame_builds_no_holder_outline`: counter test, and a changed input builds once.
- `tool_library_mockup::the_preview_toggles_hide_the_dimension_lines_and_the_holder`
- `tool_library_mockup::a_document_row_has_a_cached_drawing_and_its_gauge_length`: gauge value, counter test, a changed tool builds its drawing once.
- `tool_library_mockup::the_categories_filter_the_list`
- `tool_library_mockup::the_window_shows_the_recipes_table_and_the_preview_side_by_side` (1920 x 1080 shell)
- `page_layout_tool_library::layout_window_holders`
- Review fix: `tool_library_mockup::the_side_view_draws_the_tool_on_a_960_px_screen` (960 x 720 shell, Side view, Dimensions on; it also checks `rail_w` and `columns`).
- Review fix: `tool_library_mockup::the_side_view_without_dimensions_takes_their_room_on_a_960_px_screen`.
- The two review-fix tests read a draw counter in `side_view` (`drawn()`), so they fail on the early return. They ran red on `3c622f8e5` ("the Side view painted no drawing (0 -> 0)") and green on `29af2e3e1`.

New (app): `tool_library_holders::used_by::the_used_by_count_counts_tools_by_entry` (in `crates/app/tests/tool_library_holders/used_by.rs`, a `#[path]` module of the existing suite; its gate map now names `app::tool_body`).

Updated: `page_layout_tool_library::layout_window_tool_library` (the switch, the categories left of the rows) and `layout_window_tool_editor` (the preview and its toggles right of the rows).

The `#[test]` count of `crates/ui` goes from 1801 to 1811 (1809 before the review fix). No test is deleted. No snapshot PNG changed.

The tests were written with the code. They were not run red as a separate step, because a red run costs one more full build on the shared Windows machine. During the work, the existing window tests did catch one defect of the new layout: a full-height column separator pushed Apply out of the window. The separator now has the column's height.

## Gate (Windows, winbuild, head 3c622f8e5 merged with origin/main)
- Dry run first: `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main --dry-run` planned 36 steps (app build, app lib, 16 app suites that the `tool_body.rs` gate maps reach, ui build, ui lib, 16 ui suites).
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` (origin/main `b13ebd440`): 36 steps, 36 ok, 0 failed, 0 stalled, wall 10.1 min. ui lib 1629 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored. app lib 307 passed. `tool_library_holders` 9 passed. The ui lib and `tool_library_holders` steps ran each pinning test above.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: exit 0.
- No heavy step: this issue is P4, not P1. No post or toolpath changed, so no `example_catalog*` suite applies. The light lane was not run.
- **Commit 1 alone does not compile.** When I split the work into two commits, the first commit's `state_tool_library_dialog.rs` lost the `ToolEditorView` struct (`cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui` on `dd129ab43`: E0425/E0422, the type is not found). The branch was already pushed, and this project does not rebase or force-push, so the commit stays as it is. The second commit has the struct, and the final tree is the tree that the gate above tested. A bisect that stops on `dd129ab43` must step to `3c622f8e5`.

## Gate of the review fix (macOS, head `29af2e3e1`)
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 36 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, wall 6.6 min. ui lib 1630 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored. app lib 307 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: exit 0. The fix does not touch `camcraft-app`.
- The branch merges cleanly with origin/main (`git merge-tree`), so I did not merge main.

## Not exercised
- A machine that states a spindle taper: the seeded machine's taper is read through `machine::document_of`; the order is pinned on `holders::tapers`, not through a mounted machine with a taper in the shell.
- An inch document: the holder and gauge values use `units::len`, not pinned in inches.
- The TTS and straight-shank holders' drawings are drawn by the same code; only `BT40 ER32` is opened in a test.
- A hand resize of the window below its minimum width.

## Left for U7 (#3898)
User holders, holder edits (one undo step that updates each tool that uses the holder), New holder, Import and Export of holders, "My library", and the holder key change to the `library_ref` of #3645.

Changelog: The tool library window lists the built-in holders by taper, with the tools that use each one, and shows a holder to scale. Its editor shows the preview right of the rows, with Dimensions and Holder toggles; the tool list has categories, a small drawing of each tool and a gauge length column; and the window opens wide enough for the Recipes table and the preview.
